releases.name: OpenCode Native Dictate 0.1.0
releases.body:
Initial public preview of OpenCode Native Dictate, an offline macOS dictation plugin for OpenCode v2.

- Transcribes locally with NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B by default, with Qwen3-ASR as an optional backend.
- Captures audio through macOS and inserts the transcript into the active prompt for review; it never submits the prompt automatically.
- Targets Apple Silicon and OpenCode 2.1.4. Ghostty is the primary tested terminal.
- Basic live dictation has been confirmed in Ghostty after granting microphone permission. Automated Swift, Python and Node checks pass, including Node 20 and Node 24 CI.

The full editor, microphone lifecycle, network-disabled transcription and clean npm-install acceptance matrix remains in progress. See the README and acceptance results for details.
